title: AB Yachts Launches High-Speed AB95S Sport Edition
description: AB Yachts introduces the AB95S, a 28.5-meter sport yacht boasting incredible 53-knot speeds, innovative carbon fiber construction, and luxurious amenities.
html:
The Italian Shipyard Unveils A 28-Meter Composite Marvel Capable Of Thrilling Speeds

The launch of the AB95S took place at the AB Yachts facilities in Viareggio, marking a highly anticipated milestone a year and a half after the model was initially announced. This exciting debut follows the introduction of the cruising-oriented AB95, which made waves at the Cannes Yachting Festival. Now, the sportier sibling has hit the water, showcasing an aggressive silhouette, an aerodynamic profile, and flowing lines that emphasize its pure racing character.

The ambitious project was developed by Marco Casamonti, the head of Archea Associati and artistic director of the Next Yacht Group, the parent company of the AB Yachts brand. Adding to its impressive pedigree, the vessel features a high-tech helm station engineered in collaboration with the renowned Italian shipbuilding giant, Fincantieri. Together, these design powerhouses have crafted a profile that seamlessly blends high-performance aesthetics with cutting-edge marine technology.

Performance is where the AB95S truly commands attention. Both the hull and the superstructure are constructed from advanced composite materials, utilizing extensive carbon fiber to significantly reduce the overall weight. This lightweight foundation allows the triple MAN V12X engines, each producing 2,200 horsepower, to propel the vessel to a staggering top speed of 53 knots. Furthermore, the yacht features a remarkably shallow draft of just 1.35 meters, making it the perfect vessel for navigating wild, shallow bays and exclusive marinas with excellent maneuverability.

While the sport version sacrifices the roof sunpad in favor of a sleek hatch to maintain its aerodynamic edge, it compensates with an abundance of luxurious outdoor living space. The main deck offers three distinct lounge areas, including a spacious bow lounge, a welcoming cockpit with a dining table, and an aft beach platform. This platform is equipped with a comfortable sofa and cleverly conceals access to the garage, which is capable of housing a four-meter tender, jet skis, and various water toys.

Below deck, the 6.8-meter beam provides a surprisingly voluminous and comfortable interior capable of accommodating eight guests and a crew of two. The shipyard has heavily utilized insulated panels, alongside premium leather and suede finishes, to create a cozy atmosphere while drastically reducing noise levels while underway. As the AB95S prepares to showcase its technical prowess during upcoming sea trials, the shipyard remains confident that the model will captivate owners seeking pure adrenaline and the unforgettable thrill of high-speed luxury yachting.
